method.name: NMS system-address seed indexPrimedPRNG
method.computation: Apply indexPrimedPRNG to the 64-bit universe address; take the low 32 bits as system_seed_hex, matching systemAttributes(). This is the public address-derived system seed, not the 64-bit dungeon-root candidate.
method.independent_reimplementation: JavaScript BigInt fixed-width 64-bit port of the cited rotation/mixing/index logic; no external code copied into Surveyor.
